subject: Throughput acceleration plan & rate-scaling proposal
messages:
From: Tara Kapoor <tara@cloudlynx.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 01 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted capacity ramp — need higher monthly commit and scaled rates

Hi Priya,

Quick note from CloudLynx — our Q4 product launch pushed more traffic into our recommendation path and we're hitting the soft limits on the current hosted commit. Q3 usage attached for visibility.

Specifically:
- Average monthly tokens (gen + chat): ~1.8B (spiky day peaks ~120M tokens)
- Current committed plan: 1.0B/mo (we pay overage at standard hosted rates)
- Desired commit: bump to 2.5B/mo to stabilize unit costs; optional 4.0B/mo for burst runway

We'd like a proposal that:
1) Shows per-token pricing at the 2.5B and 4.0B tiers (including any volume discounts),
2) Confirms rate limits / concurrency guarantees per route (recommendation vs chat),
3) Lays out a migration date and rollback plan (we prefer a canary for the first two weeks).

Also flagging procurement — if there's a standard PO path and contract addendum we can use, include links. We're aiming to finalize by 2026-11-10.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

—Tara
Tara Kapoor
Head of Platform Engineering, CloudLynx
attachments: CloudLynx_usage_report_Q3.csv
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Tara Kapoor <tara@cloudlynx.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 01 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted capacity ramp — need higher monthly commit and scaled rates

Thanks for the data, Tara — and congrats on the launch momentum. I reviewed the attached Q3 report. High level response below; attaching a formal proposal (Redwood_Throughput_Proposal_v2.pdf).

Summary proposal (high level) — options:
- Option A (2.5B/mo commit): 20% unit discount vs current overage rate; per-route concurrency baseline 60 rps for recommendation, 30 rps for chat. Can enable autoscale bursts up to 120 rps on predefined routes.
- Option B (4.0B/mo commit): 28% unit discount; baseline concurrency 100 rps rec / 50 rps chat; dedicated KV-prefetch caching enabled for rec route to reduce billed tokens on repeats.

Migration plan:
- Week 0: Sign addendum (we'll draft) + PO from CloudLynx
- Week 1: Canary rollout (10% traffic) with tracing flags; daily quality and latency check-ins
- Week 2: Ramp to 50% if latency and quality stable; full cutover end of Week 3
- Fallback: instant routing to previous commit variant and reserved burst credits during rollback window

Call to action: please confirm which option you want pricing for (A vs B) and whether you want us to include a 12- or 24-month term. If you want to move fast I can loop in Finance for an approval path and send a draft addendum tomorrow.

Attachments: Redwood_Throughput_Proposal_v2.pdf

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: CloudLynx — throughput options 

Markus / Vanessa — forwarding CloudLynx thread. TL;DR: they're asking to move from 1B to either 2.5B or 4B commit. They want pricing, rate guarantees per route, and a canary rollout.

Questions for sign-off:
- Can Finance approve the indicated volume discounts (20% / 28%) for a 12-month commit? They may ask for additional credit for a 24-month term.
- Ops: confirm we can guarantee the stated concurrency baselines per route and autoscale burst SLA (we usually provide best-effort bursts, want to make this explicit).
- Legal/Procurement: do we have a light addendum template for hosted commit increases that covers rollback and data retention clauses?

I'll draft a short addendum and the HubSpot deal note if you can confirm the pricing authority and capacity guarantees. I propose we push Option A for a quick close and present Option B as a preferred tier.

—Priya
(Quoted) On Sun, 01 Nov 2026 at 11:03 AM Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for the data, Tara — and congrats on the launch momentum. I reviewed the attached Q3 report. High level response below; attaching a formal proposal (Redwood_Throughput_Proposal_v2.pdf).
From: Tara Kapoor <tara@cloudlynx.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 16:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted capacity ramp — need higher monthly commit and scaled rates

Priya / Markus — thanks for the fast turnaround. CloudLynx is comfortable moving forward with Option A (2.5B/mo) on a 12-month term to start; we'll evaluate Option B at renewal if traffic keeps scaling. Procurement will issue a PO by 2026-11-08.

Couple quick asks before PO:
- Please include a clause for a 30-day lookback on burst usage and a 90-day price-lock for the first 30 days post-cutover.
- Confirm that we can enable the KV-prefetch cache on the recommendation route during Week 2 ramp (helps reduce repeat token billing).

If those two items look OK, we'll proceed with PO and sign the addendum. Happy to get on a quick sync if you prefer to walk through the plan.

Thanks —
Tara
Head of Platform Engineering, CloudLynx
CloudLynx Procurement cc'd: procurement@cloudlynx.com
